steps.step_name: Student opens a ticket in Sipac
CRA opens the process in Sipac
Forward the process for checking any pending issues
Notify student about any pending issues via email
Enter information into the academic system

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Missing documents or incorrect information from students
exceptions.recovery: Follow up and request the right documents or corrections; can take an additional 15 to 30 minutes depending on student response

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Delays from other departments during coordination
exceptions.impact: Impacts the overall process timeline and requires constant follow-up
exceptions.recovery: Proactive follow-up and chasing; can take about an extra hour depending on the issue and workload

exceptions.what_goes_wrong: Unexpected technical issues with Sipac or other systems
exceptions.impact: Disruptive and slows down work; can take a few hours to resolve
exceptions.recovery: Troubleshooting or contacting IT for support
